@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+import type { DefaultError, QueryStatus } from './types'
+
+const persisterRestoreResultSymbol = Symbol('persisterRestoreResult')
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError> {
+  [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true
+  data?: TData
+  state?: QueryState<TData, TError>
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(restored: {
+  data?: TData
+  state?: QueryState<TData, TError>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true,
+    data: restored.data ?? restored.state?.data,
+    state: restored.state,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(
+  value: unknown,
+): value is PersisterRestoreResult {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    (value as any)[persisterRestoreResultSymbol] === true
+  )
+}
+
+export function reconcileQueryState<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError>(
+  existingState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+  persistedState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+): QueryState<TData, TError> {
+  const persistedData = persistedState.data
+  const existingData = existingState.data
+
+  const persistedHasNewerData =
+    persistedData !== undefined &&
+    (existingData === undefined ||
+      persistedState.dataUpdatedAt > existingState.dataUpdatedAt)
+
+  const data = persistedHasNewerData ? persistedData : existingData
+  const dataUpdatedAt = persistedHasNewerData
+    ? persistedState.dataUpdatedAt
+    : existingState.dataUpdatedAt
+  const dataUpdateCount = persistedHasNewerData
+    ? persistedState.dataUpdateCount
+    : existingState.dataUpdateCount
+
+  const persistedError = persistedState.error
+  const existingError = existingState.error
+
+  const persistedHasNewerError =
+    persistedError !== null &&
+    (existingError === null ||
+      persistedState.errorUpdatedAt > existingState.errorUpdatedAt)
+
+  const error = persistedHasNewerError ? persistedError : existingError
+  const errorUpdatedAt = persistedHasNewerError
+    ? persistedState.errorUpdatedAt
+    : existingState.errorUpdatedAt
+  const errorUpdateCount = persistedHasNewerError
+    ? persistedState.errorUpdateCount
+    : existingState.errorUpdateCount
+  const fetchFailureCount = persistedHasNewerError
+    ? persistedState.fetchFailureCount
+    : existingState.fetchFailureCount
+  const fetchFailureReason = persistedHasNewerError
+    ? persistedState.fetchFailureReason
+    : existingState.fetchFailureReason
+
+  const isInvalidated =
+    existingState.isInvalidated || persistedState.isInvalidated
+
+  let status: QueryStatus
+  if (error !== null) {
+    status = 'error'
+  } else if (data !== undefined) {
+    status = 'success'
+  } else {
+    status = existingState.status ?? persistedState.status
+  }
+
+  return {
+    ...existingState,
+    ...persistedState,
+    data,
+    dataUpdatedAt,
+    dataUpdateCount,
+    error,
+    errorUpdatedAt,
+    errorUpdateCount,
+    fetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason,
+    isInvalidated,
+    status,
+    fetchStatus: existingState.fetchStatus,
+  }
+}

+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { waitFor } from '@testing-library/react'
+import * as React from 'react'
+import {
+  QueryClient,
+  createPersisterRestoreResult,
+  useQuery,
+} from '../index'
+import { renderWithClient } from './utils'
+
+describe('useQuery with createPersisterRestoreResult', () => {
+  it('exposes restored failure count, error, and isRefetchError to React components on mount', async () => {
+    const queryClient = new QueryClient()
+
+    const restoredState = {
+      data: 'restored data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      error: new Error('restored refetch error'),
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      fetchFailureCount: 3,
+      fetchFailureReason: new Error('restored refetch error'),
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'error' as const,
+      fetchStatus: 'idle' as const,
+    }
+
+    const persister = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(
+      createPersisterRestoreResult({
+        data: 'restored data',
+        state: restoredState,
+      }),
+    )
+
+    const results: Array<any> = []
+
+    function Component() {
+      const queryResult = useQuery({
+        queryKey: ['persistedReactKey'],
+        queryFn: () => Promise.resolve('fresh data'),
+        persister,
+        staleTime: 10000,
+      })
+
+      results.push(queryResult)
+
+      return (
+        <div>
+          <div data-testid="data">{queryResult.data}</div>
+          <div data-testid="error">{queryResult.error?.message}</div>
+          <div data-testid="failureCount">{queryResult.failureCount}</div>
+          <div data-testid="isRefetchError">
+            {queryResult.isRefetchError ? 'true' : 'false'}
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      )
+    }
+
+    const { getByTestId } = renderWithClient(queryClient, <Component />)
+
+    await waitFor(() => {
+      expect(getByTestId('data').textContent).toBe('restored data')
+    })
+
+    expect(getByTestId('error').textContent).toBe('restored refetch error')
+    expect(getByTestId('failureCount').textContent).toBe('3')
+    expect(getByTestId('isRefetchError').textContent).toBe('true')
+
+    const lastResult = results[results.length - 1]
+    expect(lastResult.failureCount).toBe(3)
+    expect(lastResult.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(1000)
+    expect(lastResult.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+    expect(lastResult.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+  })
+})
